title: The Bow and the Axes
sub: String the bow, line up the twelve axes, loose

string.hand: Pinch with both hands and pull them apart to string the bow.
string.mouse: Press and drag away to draw the string.

aim.hand: Hold the pinch; move until the sight sits in the rings of all twelve axes.
aim.mouse: Keep pressing; move the sight into the rings.
aim.keys: Hold Space; arrows move the sight.

loose.hand: Open your hand to loose the arrow.
